text.content:
The priest at La Catrina.

Role: Fixer (Fixer 7)
Affiliation: La Catrina; trusted by the Valentinos
Where to find them: La Catrina (#39), Vista del Rey
Known for: Jobs for edgerunners who need to make amends, and for Valentinos who need deniability

The priest at La Catrina, Vista del Rey's shrine, chapel and community center, where Día de los Muertos starts. He arranges work for edgerunners who need to make amends, and for Valentinos who need deniability.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.10
